let dataset = requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where url has "$initiativeId"
;
dataset
| summarize  Avg = avg(duration)/1000, 95Prc = percentile( duration,95)/1000, 99Prc = percentile( duration,99)/1000, Count = count()
| project operation_Name="All", Avg, 95Prc, 99Prc, Count
| union(dataset
| summarize  Avg = avg(duration)/1000, 95Prc = percentile( duration,95)/1000, 99Prc = percentile( duration,99)/1000, Count = count() by operation_Name
| top 20 by Avg desc
| order by Count
)

KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2m)
| where ClusterName == "cstar-u-itn-uat-aks"
| where Namespace == "idpay"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ContainerName
| project Name, ContainerName
| join kind = inner (
    Perf
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2m)
    | where ObjectName == 'K8SContainer'
    | where CounterName == 'cpuLimitNanoCores'
    | where InstanceName contains 'cstar-u-itn-uat-aks'
    | extend ContainerNameParts = split(InstanceName, '/')
    | extend ContainerNamePartCount = array_length(ContainerNameParts)            
    | extend PodUIDIndex = ContainerNamePartCount - 2, ContainerNameIndex = ContainerNamePartCount - 1 
    | extend ContainerName = strcat(ContainerNameParts[PodUIDIndex], '/', ContainerNameParts[ContainerNameIndex])
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ContainerName
    | project ContainerName, CpuLimit=CounterValue
    | join kind = inner (
        Perf
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(2m)
        | where ObjectName == 'K8SContainer'
        | where CounterName == 'cpuUsageNanoCores'
        | where InstanceName contains 'cstar-u-itn-uat-aks'
        | extend ContainerNameParts = split(InstanceName, '/')
        | extend ContainerNamePartCount = array_length(ContainerNameParts)            
        | extend PodUIDIndex = ContainerNamePartCount - 2, ContainerNameIndex = ContainerNamePartCount - 1 
        | extend ContainerName = strcat(ContainerNameParts[PodUIDIndex], '/', ContainerNameParts[ContainerNameIndex])
        | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ContainerName
        | project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, CpuUsage=CounterValue
    ) on ContainerName
) on ContainerName
| order by Name asc
| project Name, CpuLimit=(CpuLimit / 1000000), CpuUsage=(CpuUsage / 1000000)

| where isnotempty(initiativeId)

| distinct __text = initiativeValue, __value = initiativeValue
| order by __text asc
